Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1447
Claimant:
Allen Johnson
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
August 27, 2023
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection. Claimant reports a back strain and is represented by counsel, so
all further contact will route through the attorney's office.
September 4, 2023
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of impact. The driver is named on the
policy and coverage was in force on the loss date.
September 7, 2023
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses and photos from the scene. Both witnesses describe the
collision the same way the claimant and the other driver did.
December 3, 2023
Spoke with the other driver, whose account matches the claimant's on the sequence of events at the intersection. No
discrepancies found in the core facts.
December 9, 2023
Inspected the vehicle photos. The damage is largely consistent with the described side impact and the points of
contact line up with the reported angle.
December 10, 2023
Requested prior calims history and repair records for the vehicle. Nothing shows earlier damage to the same areas,
and no prior loss has been filed on this unit.
December 13, 2023
Medical records recieved from the initial treating facility. The back strain diagnosis fits the kind and force of the crash,
and no earlier injury to that body area appears in the file.
January 4, 2024
Claimant's counsel provided a follow-up letter with a few additional details about the moments afetr impact. The core
account has not changed from the first statement.
January 11, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with care tapering as the claimant improved. Latest therapy notes describe
steady progress and reduced reported pain.
January 12, 2024
Reviewed all materials to date. Nothing in the file suggests the damage or injury predates the policy's effective date.
File remains open pending final medical billing from the provider.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
